independence.scope: 2021 base-game first printing, Law October 20 2020, corresponding full Playbook, official base errata updated November 15 2022; complete multiplayer, Chronicle and later-game setup. Clockwork Prince and New Foundations excluded.
independence.method: Entire candidate, Law, Playbook and errata delivered model-visibly in contiguous bounded chunks before conclusion; all original characters preserved. Independent comparison against full permitted sources and visual diagrams; no questions, answer keys, grades, readers, prior audits, history, change files or protocols read.

checked: Finite components; private/public information; board, bank and advisers; regions; site capacity; physical garrisons versus board force; Imperial and bandit rule; facedown sites; edifice suits and ruins.

Packet order; initial faceup/facedown sites; pawn seating and placements; purple garrisons; warbands/resources/Supply; banners and favor banks; ordered deck and discard seeds; advisers; Ivory Eye/Reliquary/relic deck; three-player walkthrough transition.

sourcelocators: Law 1, steps 1–23 and rebuild-deck inset, pp. 2–3
checked: Saved map and goal; Chancellor/board selection; Citizens receive no setup relic; resource allocations; starting garrisons; banner awards; random Reliquary spaces; bottom-of-deck discard/adviser draws; Visions track and pawn choices.

sourcelocators: Playbook pp. 10–11 and player board diagrams p. 3
checked: Wake ordering and Mob repetition; victory before title flip; optional site income; Act repeat/finish rules; Rest resource returns and secret readiness; exact Citizen refresh; numerical Chancellor/Exile tiers and unspent Supply.

Source choices and costs; mandatory draw-three/stop rules; no required reveal of drawn card fronts; discard-before-play; capacity and favor; facedown advisers/reveal minor action; limit changers and locks; true Vision placement; Conspiracy match/theft; regional discard destinations; Peoples Favor discard/play flexibility.

Supply and resource costs; empty suited site cards; adviser match yields; Citizens muster purple; finite favor/warbands and unlimited secrets/dice; cost outside turn; facedown secret restrictions; battle-plan payment exception.

Relic availability and site costs; banner outbids and redistribution; corrected existential unmatched-suit restriction including zero advisers, empty site and ruin cases; self/shared recovery; seizure penalties versus Recover; Mob maintenance.

Defender eligibility; local target and mandatory site; remote sites and co-located relic/banner/pawn targets; force-based attack pool; title modifier; plans, empty attack-pool removal; shields/doubles and board/site defenses; skulls/hollow swords/exact sacrifices; ties; defeat casualties before targets; voluntary zero occupation, all relics, independent banishment/favor burn; defender victorious effects; end discards and end-of-Campaign Supremacy transfer.

sourcelocators: Errata 5.5 power-sharing guidance and Grand Scepter
checked: Automatic Chancellor Ally and optional qualified Citizens; mandatory modifiers; shared power pronouns with own site/board exception; one use/payor per shared plan; declared defender priority; Chancellor casualty choices and survivor destinations; temporary non-Imperial status; shared purple rule and warband transfers; Scepter timing; exactly one offered Reliquary relic and binding exchange; conversion/forced Citizenship; revealed modifier effects; exile cost formula and self-exile/Act termination.

sourcelocators: Site Reference p. 2, every site entry
checked: Full regional Travel matrix; destination reveal resources/relics; fixed costs then modifiers and free-Travel override; all Opportunity/Homeland/Coast/Plains/Mountain/River/Charming Valley/Shrouded Wood/Narrow Pass/Great Slum/Marshes/Buried Giant/Hidden Place/Tribunal powers; banishment restrictions; Homeland same-suit discard condition and reward order; exhausted-secret costs.

All four Oaths and four corresponding Visions; incumbent ties and outgoing-holder choice; Empire site count; Usurper two-Wake sequence and round-eight alternative; global three-Visions gate and strict-most requirement; every Oath-specific Successor goal; stable-regime roll thresholds; full war-exhaustion priority and Vision tiebreaks; Citizen replacement of any Chancellor win.

sourcelocators: Errata Draw, You, Enemy, Rule and Give/Take clarifications
checked: Access/persistent effects; power costs/exhaustion; resolve as much as possible; standalone timing; mandatory modifiers; restriction banners/locks; adviser limits; Bandit Crown; exact glossary transfers, After, Peek/Reveal, Move/Swap, Draw; rules hierarchy and must/cannot/ignore; binding promises and Tribunal; information and group options.

First Archive opening; Vision-only versus other Oath selection; free Chronicle Citizenship excluding self and just-exiled Citizens, saved board conversion and one winner warband per accepting site; build/repair one edifice; retained/discarded map cards and ruins with denizens; exact region compression/reverse ruin order; Archive suit additions and healing; losers advisers/dispossessing; relic refill and stacking; saved map/boards and optional new players; corrected 10+2 and 15+3 deck strata.

conclusion: Zero material source errors or omissions found within the specified multiplayer base-game scope. The candidate incorporates the provided official errata and agrees with the inspected Site Reference and setup/board diagrams.

deliveryreceipts.line_endings: Direct UTF-8 decoding without newline normalization; LF source files and original CRLF errata retained.
deliveryreceipts.output_limits: All final qualifying deliveries use explicit outer functions.exec max_output_tokens 7000 and nested exec_command max_output_tokens 7000, at most two <=5000-character chunks per call. Initial non-explicit-limit ranges were completely redelivered with the required limits.
deliveryreceipts.truncation: No final qualifying chunk truncated; BEGIN and END boundaries inspected for every chunk.
